summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing for JC Cardio. All 20 pytest backend cases passed (auth, patients, cases, file uploads to object storage, file serving with ?auth=, presentations PDF/PPTX validation, auth guards). Full frontend flow verified via Playwright: landing renders with hero + testids, contact form submits with success toast, login/logout works, dashboard tabs switch, patient creation, case creation with modal + upload panels, case presentation dark card renders with all sections and back-to-dashboard, slides tab uploads PDF and opens viewer with all toolbar buttons and iframe. Wrong credentials show error and stay on /login. Protected /dashboard redirects to /login when logged out.

issues: SlideViewer and CaseModal overlays do not close on Escape keypress. Only the X button or backdrop click closes them. Minor UX polish.
doLogout uses nav('/') but URL ends up at /login (likely fine since token is cleared and landing route may pass, but spec expected landing). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add Escape-key listener to CaseModal and SlideViewer for keyboard accessibility.
(Optional) Verify logout should route to '/' (landing) instead of ending up at '/login'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores base64/binary files via requests (sync) inside async endpoints—acceptable but blocks the event loop for large uploads; consider httpx.AsyncClient.
Presentations upload accepts .ppt but classifies as 'pptx'—minor label mismatch (spec asked only pdf/pptx).
PPTX accepted purely by extension; no content sniffing. Fine for MVP.
CORS uses env CORS_ORIGINS with default '*' plus allow_credentials=True which browsers disallow; ok since PROTECTED origins usually override, but consider explicit origins in prod.
seed_data_creation: Playwright run created TEST_PW_Paciente patient, TEST_PW_case case (with uploaded lab/ekg/eco files), and TEST_PW_slide presentation under jcascante's account. Pytest also created TEST_-prefixed patients/cases/presentations; delete tests soft-delete their targets but other TEST_ artifacts remain in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_jccardio_api.py for regression. When testing UI, note: (1) case-patient is a native <select> not shadcn, use select_option; (2) CaseModal stays open after case-save so subsequent Dashboard clicks require closing modal via X button or backdrop; (3) SlideViewer only closes via its X button (no Escape handler); (4) new-slide-btn triggers file chooser via expect_file_chooser.
